Name: The Pretty Valley Project
Author: NesrynRoseAstra
Description:
[heading][u][size=6]🌸 Pretty Valley The Project 🌸[/size][/u][/heading]
[i][size=4]One Content Patcher mod. One soft pastel Stardew Valley.[/size][/i]
Sage-mint grass, blush-rose dirt, pink sand, lilac water, soft blue snow, white-and-pastel buildings, flower-trimmed menus, pastel animals and Junimos in bloom. Image edits only: no data, items, NPCs, maps or events are changed, and nothing is written to your save.

[size=5]✨ What it changes[/size]

[b][u][size=4]🌿 Nature[/size][/u][/b]
[list]
[*]Grass, dirt, beach sand and the seasonal outdoor, beach, island and town tilesheets, with optional wildflowers in the grass[/*]
[*]Oak, maple, pine, palm, mushroom, mystic and fruit trees; berry, tea and decorative bushes; crop and flower growth stages[/*]
[*]Pastel lilac water: rivers, lakes, ponds, ocean, Ginger Island and shoreline foam[/*]
[*]Soft pastel blue snow in winter, including Ginger Island and the Festival of Ice[/*]
[*]Beach rocks stay natural brown and grey so they stand out from the pink sand[/*]
[*]Seasonal vines and flowers on town buildings, flower beds, fences and benches[/*]
[/list][b][u][size=4]🏡 Farm[/size][/u][/b]
[list]
[*]Barns, coops, stable, shed, silo, well, mill, slime hutch, Plank and Stone cabins: white and pastel with edge vines and flowers, white doors and windows[/*]
[*]Whitewashed farmhouse with a pink porch, window boxes, lilac door mats and a mossy roof whose blooms change with the season[/*]
[*]Greenhouse with seasonal blooms[/*]
[*]Cloud shipping bin (with lid animation) and a magical mailbox in all four seasons[/*]
[*]Pastel pink machines with rainbow symbols and cloud-latch chests[/*]
[*]Sprinklers in your choice of style: Toadstool, Frog, Teacup or Vanilla[/*]
[/list][b][u][size=4]🐄 Animals, Junimos and Joja[/size][/u][/b]
[list]
[*]Every farm animal and pet breed in its own pastel, with deep plum outlines[/*]
[*]Junimos with a flower and leaves, a mossy Junimo Hut, and Luma (East Scarp)[/*]
[*]Joja Mart in lilac and blush, inside and out[/*]
[/list][b][size=4][u]🚌 Town and world[/u][/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Seasonal hippie bus with flowers and rainbow stripes[/*]
[*]Softer, cozier, less vibrant colors inside the town buildings, and inside Sunberry Village and Mount Vapius buildings too[/*]
[*]Pastel mine monsters and floral weapons[/*]
[/list][b][u][size=4]💌 Interface[/size][/u][/b]
[list]
[*]Blush-pink menus, dialogue boxes, tooltips, toolbar, tabs and buttons[/*]
[*]HUD, title screen with a sunset backdrop, letters, billboard, bundle page, special orders board and forge[/*]
[*]Flower-trimmed tools, rods, pans, trash cans and scythes[/*]
[/list][u][b][size=4]⚙️ Options[/size][/b][/u]
Everything is on by default and every part has its own on/off switch. Generic Mod Config Menu is supported.
[list]
[*][b]Strength:[/b] Soft, Medium or Strong palette[/*]
[*][b]Nature:[/b] RecolorTerrain, RecolorTrees, RecolorBushes, RecolorCropsAndFlowers, WildflowerGrass, PurpleWater, PastelSnow, SeasonalFlora, SoftInteriors[/*]
[*][b]Farm:[/b] RecolorBuildings, RecolorFarmhouse, RecolorShippingBin, RecolorMailbox, RecolorMachines, SprinklerStyle[/*]
[*][b]Creatures and places:[/b] RecolorAnimals, RecolorJunimos, RecolorJoja, RecolorBus, RecolorMonsters, RecolorWeapons[/*]
[*][b]Interface:[/b] EnableMenus, EnableHud, EnableTitle, EnableBoards, EnableTools, Florals[/*]
[/list][b][u][size=4]📦 Requirements[/size][/u][/b]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+, SMAPI 4.0+, Content Patcher 2.5.0+[/*]
[*]Optional, auto-detected: Stardew Valley Expanded, DaisyNiko’s Tilesheets, Ridgeside Village, East Scarp Village, Lilybrook / Central Station, [b]Lunna Astray, Sunberry Village, Mount Vapius, Distant Lands[/b][/*]
[/list][b][u][size=4]🤝 Compatibility[/size][/u][/b]
[list]
[*][b]Stardew Valley Expanded:[/b] pastel SVE trees; bus and tilesheet recolors carry over. SVE’s Galdoran menus win unless you set DisableGaldoranTheme to true in SVE’s config[/*]
[*][b]Ridgeside Village:[/b] pastel terrain, waterfalls, trees and the flower bus[/*]
[*][b]East Scarp Village:[/b] pastel terrain, DeepDark water and a recolored Luma[/*]
[*][b]Lilybrook / Central Station:[/b] the flower bus shows after the bus ride[/*]
[*]🆕 [b]Lunna Astray:[/b] pastel terrain, trees, fruit trees, bushes, plants and waterfall[/*]
[*]🆕 [b]Sunberry Village:[/b] pastel outdoor tilesheets, trees, orchard, cindertrees and waterfall, plus soft interiors[/*]
[*]🆕 [b]Mount Vapius:[/b] pastel terrain, 34 trees, fruit trees, bushes, water plants and snow-day variants, plus soft interiors[/*]
[*]🆕 [b]Distant Lands:[/b] pastel swamp trees and plants[/*]
[*]Buildings and NPCs of these mods are left as drawn. Interiors from the shared Lumisteria indoor tilesheet pack are not softened yet[/*]
[*]Farm buildings, animals and Junimos beat other mods that edit the same image. Turn the matching option off to keep another mod’s look (e.g. RecolorFarmhouse with Leafy Cottage)[/*]
[*]Left as vanilla: wooden-roofed cabins, obelisks, Gold Clock, Fish Pond, pet bowls, woodpiles, abandoned Joja Mart[/*]
[/list][u][b][size=4]❄️ Optional companion mod[/size][/b][/u]
[b][u]Pretty Valley Snowflakes[/u][/b] (separate SMAPI mod) replaces the dot-like falling snow with soft pastel-rainbow snowflake shapes that drift and sway.

[u][b][size=4]🔁 Replaces these mods[/size][/b][/u] (delete them first)
[CP] Pretty Valley, [CP] Pretty Valley - SVE and DaisyNiko Add-on, PrettyValleyBinAndMailbox, [CP] Seasonal Hippie Bus, [CP] Meadow Cottage UI. The unique ID is new, so update any mod that depends on an old ID.

[b][u][size=4]🛠️ Install / update / uninstall[/size][/u][/b]
[list]
[*][b]Install:[/b] put the [CP] Pretty Valley The Project folder in Mods[/*]
[*][b]Update:[/b] delete the old folder, then copy in the new one. Do not merge[/*]
[*][b]Uninstall:[/b] delete the folder[/*]
[/list]

Manifest.Name: Pretty Valley The Project
Manifest.Description: A cute pastel, cottagecore recolor of Stardew Valley: nature, town flora, UI, tools, machines, weapons, monsters, sprinklers and water, all in one pack with config options.
Manifest.Author: Nesryn Astra Rose
